description: This Dart file defines a class that manages session tokens using shared preferences for persistent storage, providing methods to set, retrieve, and clear access tokens.

classes.name: SessionStore
classes.description: A utility class for storing, retrieving, and clearing an access token for app sessions using shared preferences.

methods.name: setAccessToken
methods.description: Stores an access token asynchronously in shared preferences.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored access token asynchronously.
